title: Creamy garlic spinach with lamb chops and Bramley

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every item is a whole food or a plain dairy staple, with nothing from a jar or packet.

supermarket.reason: Lamb chops, new potatoes, spinach, Bramleys and crème fraîche are all everyday Tesco lines.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs one roasting tray, a knife and a board, and the technique is simple roasting.

works.reason: The timings, the 220°C oven and the quantities suit four, and adding the spinach in two batches lets it wilt without crowding the tray.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers halving the potatoes and cutting the onions, apples and garlic, and the steps add up to about 45 minutes in the oven.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Half a kilo of spinach in a creamy garlic base is the centre of a hearty April traybake, with stored Bramleys alongside.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lamb, potatoes, plenty of greens and fruit make a proper family dinner.
